purpose: Replace the legacy strict fixed-role revocation constraint with the intended non-strict constraint.
lockImpact: Takes a bounded table lock while replacing two check-constraint names in the reset local-development database.
dataImpact: No row changes; grants revoked at their grant timestamp become valid.
destructiveApproval: Approved by ADR-0034 and the 2026-08-04 reset-only local-development migration plan; only obsolete check constraints are removed and immediately replaced.
recovery: Retain the relaxed constraint during rollback because it accepts every previously valid grant interval.
forwardFix: Append another reviewed authorization-owned migration. Do not rewrite this migration after application.
